title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression enhancements and metric-based quality gating
author: Aisha Patel
body: Motivation: reduce flakiness and improve signal from eval harness runs in CI by enabling thresholded prompt-set regression checks, per-model gating, and richer metric exports to CI. Changes: add a dedicated GitHub Actions workflow (ci/eval/prompt-regression.yml) that runs the eval-harness in a lightweight mode, uploads metrics as workflow artifacts and a JSON summary, and fails the job when configured thresholds are exceeded. Introduces a new config file eval/config/prompt_regression.yaml to declare prompt-sets, per-model baselines and tolerated degradations, and metadata for gating. Adds metric exporters to the harness to produce summary metrics (accuracy, EM, ROUGE-L, token-latency, beam-diversity) and a small library to translate those into CI-friendly pass/fail checks. Adds retries and exponential backoff around the in-memory model runner to mitigate transient GPU scheduling failures in CI. Adds unit and integration tests and docs updates. See commits and changed files for details. Related: ENG-2145 (prompt-quality gating), ENG-2201 (CI metrics integration).
commits: 6 commits: 1) feat(eval): add prompt-regression CI workflow and runner wrapper, 2) feat(eval): add prompt_regression.yaml config and per-model thresholding, 3) perf(eval): metric exporter + JSON summary generator, 4) fix(ci): add retries/backoff to harness runner for CI flakiness, 5) test: add unit + integration tests for gating logic, 6) docs: update eval-harness README and CI docs.
review_comments: Diego Martinez (2026-01-16): Overall looks good but the gating thresholds are hard-coded in the example config; can we support Linear-linked baselines and env overrides?
Aisha Patel (2026-01-16): Good point - switched config to allow baseline references to Linear eval runs and env var overrides. Updated in commit 2.
Liam Chen (2026-01-20): CI job flaked in integration run - logs show GPU allocation timeouts. Please add retries and a short sleep jitter.
Aisha Patel (2026-01-21): Added exponential backoff with jitter around model init; re-ran CI and integration tests are stable.
Maya Singh (2026-01-26): Small nits: please add a short README snippet explaining how to add a new prompt-set and how to disable gating for WIP branches.
Aisha Patel (2026-01-26): Added docs snippet and examples. Ready for final review.
Liam Chen (2026-01-28): Approving - tests green and docs look good.
ci_checks: integration-eval: passed after retry (initial failure: GPU timeout)
release_notes: Add CI prompt-regression job with metric-based quality gating; new eval/config/prompt_regression.yaml; metric exporter to produce CI-friendly summaries; retries to reduce CI flakiness.
notes: Merged after 2 approvals; rollouts: enabled on main for prow and GitHub Actions CI; monitoring: added a Grafana dashboard link in docs (internal).
